about_the_game: Run through action packed levels and discover secrets, gun down enemies and obstacles in your way, grapple across gaps and tense encounters to find secrets. Bolt Runner, a 2.5D Action Platformer, was crafted out of love for some of the most iconic platformers out there. Take control of a robot soldier on the run from a ruined future as you travel through time portals to prevent a dystopian reality! Avoid obstacles like pillars that fall, hit high speeds with grind rails, and swap things up with switch blocks in a crazy factory. Collect special tokens in each level to unlock extra hard bonus levels for an even greater challenge! Are you up for the task?
